introHtml: Default decoration on custom golf polo shirts typically includes a simple one-color logo embroidery or screen print on the left chest. This cost-effective option is ideal for corporate teams, golf outings, and employee uniforms where a clean, professional look is needed without the added expense of full-color or multi-location decoration. Choose from moisture-wicking fabrics and classic fits to keep your group comfortable on the course.
